env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 375: go build accepts -O=0 with -N -l and -O=1 with no inline budget.
go build -a -x -O=0 .
stderr '\-N \-l'

go build -a -x -O=1 .
! stderr 'inlbudget'

logos build -a -x -O=s .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=15[ ,]'

go build -a -x -O=s .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=15[ ,]'
cd mixed
logos build -a -x ./helper
stderr 'GOAMD64=.*v1.*helper'

logos build -a -x .
stderr 'GOAMD64=.*v1.*-p main'
cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/optlevelvalues

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}

-- mixed/go.mod --
module example.com/optlevelvalues/mixed

go 1.27

-- mixed/logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "baseline"

-- mixed/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}

-- mixed/helper/helper.go --
package helper

func Hello() {}
